parsed_entries.requirement: Significant Data Fiduciaries must appoint a Data Protection Officer as required by law.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the organization has appointed a Data Protection Officer as required by law.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation is directly tied to the definition of a Data Protection Officer under the DPDP Act 2023.

parsed_entries.requirement: Data Fiduciaries must ensure that personal data is erased or restricted when no longer needed for the specified purpose.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the organization provides a specified purpose for data processing and ensures data is erased or restricted when no longer needed.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to Data Fiduciaries who provide a specified purpose for data processing.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation is tied to the requirement for Data Fiduciaries to provide a specified purpose and manage data retention accordingly.

parsed_entries.requirement: Data Fiduciaries must ensure that personal data is protected against unauthorized processing, accidental disclosure, or loss.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the organization has implemented measures to protect personal data against unauthorized processing, accidental disclosure, or loss.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation is directly tied to the definition of a personal data breach and the need for security safeguards.

parsed_entries.requirement: Data Fiduciaries must ensure that personal data is retained only for the specified purpose and erased when no longer needed.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the organization retains personal data only for the specified purpose and ensures erasure when no longer needed.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to Data Fiduciaries who process personal data.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation is tied to the definition of processing and the requirement to retain data only for the specified purpose.

parsed_entries.requirement: Significant Data Fiduciaries must be notified by the Central Government under section 10.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Check if the organization is classified as a Significant Data Fiduciary and if it complies with the notification requirements under section 10.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation is directly tied to the definition of a Significant Data Fiduciary and the requirement for notification by the Central Government.

parsed_entries.requirement: Data Fiduciaries must ensure that personal data is retained only for the purpose for which it was collected.
parsed_entries.checkable_test: Verify if the organization retains personal data only for the purpose for which it was collected.
parsed_entries.applicability: Applicable to Data Fiduciaries processing personal data within India.
parsed_entries.notes: This obligation is tied to the requirement that data processing within India must be for the purpose for which it was collected.
